CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_child_hear(
hospcode VARCHAR(5) not null,
pid VARCHAR(15) not null,
cid VARCHAR(13) DEFAULT null,
birth date,
date_serv date,
z_code VARCHAR(9) DEFAULT null,
procedcode  VARCHAR(9) DEFAULT null,
r_code  VARCHAR(9) DEFAULT null,
provider  VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT null,
PRIMARY KEY (hospcode,pid),

KEY (cid)
) ENGINE=myisam DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;


/*ipd*/
INSERT IGNORE INTO tmp_child_hear (hospcode,pid,cid,birth,date_serv,z_code)
SELECT p.hospcode,p.pid,p.cid,p.birth,date(d.datetime_disch),d.DIAGCODE
FROM t_person_db p 
				INNER JOIN tmp_diag_ipd d ON p.HOSPCODE=d.HOSPCODE AND p.pid=d.PID
				INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode 
WHERE p.BIRTH BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND d.DIAGCODE LIKE 'Z135%' 
AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15);

/*opd*/
INSERT IGNORE INTO tmp_child_hear (hospcode,pid,cid,birth,date_serv,z_code)
SELECT p.hospcode,p.pid,p.cid,p.birth,d.DATE_SERV,d.DIAGCODE
FROM t_person_db p 
				INNER JOIN tmp_diag_opd d ON p.HOSPCODE=d.HOSPCODE AND p.pid=d.PID
				INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode 
WHERE p.BIRTH BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND d.DIAGCODE LIKE 'Z135%' 
AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15);

INSERT IGNORE INTO tmp_child_hear (hospcode,pid,cid,birth)
SELECT p.hospcode,p.pid,p.cid,p.birth
FROM t_person_db p INNER JOIN tmp_newborn n ON p.HOSPCODE=n.HOSPCODE AND p.pid=n.PID
			INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode 

WHERE p.BIRTH BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15);

/*ipd*/
UPDATE tmp_child_hear t INNER JOIN 
(SELECT p.hospcode,p.pid,p.cid,o.PROCEDCODE
FROM t_person_db p 	INNER JOIN tmp_procedure_ipd o ON p.HOSPCODE=o.HOSPCODE AND p.pid=o.pid 
WHERE p.BIRTH BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 	AND  o.PROCEDCODE LIKE '9543%'
) z ON t.hospcode=z.hospcode AND t.pid=z.pid 
SET t.procedcode=z.procedcode;

UPDATE tmp_child_hear t INNER JOIN 
(SELECT p.hospcode,p.pid,p.cid,o.DIAGCODE
FROM t_person_db p 	INNER JOIN tmp_diag_ipd o ON p.HOSPCODE=o.HOSPCODE AND p.pid=o.pid 
WHERE p.BIRTH BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 	AND  o.DIAGCODE LIKE 'R941%'
) z ON t.hospcode=z.hospcode AND t.pid=z.pid 
SET t.r_code=z.DIAGCODE;

/*opd*/
UPDATE tmp_child_hear t INNER JOIN 
(SELECT p.hospcode,p.pid,p.cid,o.PROCEDCODE
FROM t_person_db p 	INNER JOIN tmp_procedure_opd o ON p.HOSPCODE=o.HOSPCODE AND p.pid=o.pid 
WHERE p.BIRTH BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 	AND  o.PROCEDCODE LIKE '9543%'
) z ON t.hospcode=z.hospcode AND t.pid=z.pid 
SET t.procedcode=z.procedcode;

UPDATE tmp_child_hear t INNER JOIN 
(SELECT p.hospcode,p.pid,p.cid,o.DIAGCODE
FROM t_person_db p 	INNER JOIN tmp_diag_opd o ON p.HOSPCODE=o.HOSPCODE AND p.pid=o.pid 
WHERE p.BIRTH BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 	AND  o.DIAGCODE LIKE 'R941%'
) z ON t.hospcode=z.hospcode AND t.pid=z.pid 
SET t.r_code=z.DIAGCODE;

result1 ,SUM("c_m10") AS "c_m10" ,SUM("b_m10") AS "b_m10" ,SUM("a_m10") AS "a_m10" ,SUM("c_m11") AS "c_m11" ,SUM("b_m11") AS "b_m11" ,SUM("a_m11") AS "a_m11" ,SUM("c_m12") AS "c_m12" ,SUM("b_m12") AS "b_m12" ,SUM("a_m12") AS "a_m12" ,SUM("c_m1") AS "c_m1" ,SUM("b_m1") AS "b_m1" ,SUM("a_m1") AS "a_m1" ,SUM("c_m2") AS "c_m2" ,SUM("b_m2") AS "b_m2" ,SUM("a_m2") AS "a_m2" ,SUM("c_m3") AS "c_m3" ,SUM("b_m3") AS "b_m3" ,SUM("a_m3") AS "a_m3" ,SUM("c_m4") AS "c_m4" ,SUM("b_m4") AS "b_m4" ,SUM("a_m4") AS "a_m4" ,SUM("c_m5") AS "c_m5" ,SUM("b_m5") AS "b_m5" ,SUM("a_m5") AS "a_m5" ,SUM("c_m6") AS ,SUM("c_m9") AS "c_m9" ,SUM("b_m9") AS "b_m9" ,SUM("a_m9") AS "a_m9"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN
